items.title: Does Expedia (EXPE) Golden Cross and Estimate Revisions Reveal a Shift in Market Conviction?
items.summary: Expedia Group recently saw a technical “golden cross,” with its 50-day moving average crossing above its 200-day moving average, while analysts also raised near-term earnings estimates. This combination of a widely watched bullish chart signal and improving earnings expectations has drawn fresh attention to how Expedia’s fundamentals align with market sentiment. We’ll now explore how this golden cross and upgraded earnings estimates interact with Expedia Group’s existing investment narrative...

items.summary: Corporate earnings from big U.S. companies and closely-watched jobs reports are among the key updates for Wall Street this week.
